props.text: A capsule wardrobe for a week away
A dozen pieces in one palette that all work together. Change the trip and the list and the outfits follow.
White tee with Dark jeans, Unstructured navy jacket
Navy Oxford shirt with Stone chinos, Unstructured navy jacket
Striped long-sleeve tee with Dark jeans, Unstructured navy jacket
Stone knit polo with Stone chinos, Unstructured navy jacket
White tee with Dark jeans, Unstructured navy jacket
Navy Oxford shirt with Stone chinos, Unstructured navy jacket
Striped long-sleeve tee with Dark jeans, Unstructured navy jacket
Wear the bulkiest shoes and layer on the travel day, and roll rather than fold to fit everything in a carry-on.
